This is an Expo/React Native mobile application. Prioritize mobile-first patterns, performance, and cross-platform compatibility.

Expo ships breaking changes every SDK release. APIs you remember are likely renamed, moved, or removed. Before writing any code that touches an Expo, EAS, or React Native API:

# Pokédex

A Pokédex app for Pokémon fans. You can scroll through all Pokémon, search
by name, open a Pokémon to see its details and evolutions, keep your
favorites, and compare two Pokémon side by side. All data comes live from
PokeAPI. The design follows the course Figma file.

## Core action

Find a Pokémon and see what it can do.

## Features

1. [List](./features/list.md): all Pokémon in a list, live from the API.
2. [Search](./features/search.md): find any Pokémon by part of its name.
3. [Detail](./features/detail.md): about, stats and evolution chain of one Pokémon.
4. [Favorites](./features/favorites.md): save Pokémon, still there after a restart.
5. [Compare](./features/compare.md): two Pokémon side by side, per stat who is stronger.

## Data

- **API**: [PokeAPI](https://pokeapi.co/docs/v2). Public, no key, no login.
- **Endpoints**:
  - `/pokemon?limit=...&offset=...`: names and URLs for the list and search.
  - `/pokemon/{id}`: number, artwork, types, stats, height, weight.
  - `/pokemon-species/{id}`: description text and the link to the evolution chain.
  - `/evolution-chain/{id}`: the evolution chain.
- **Stored on the phone**: table `favorites` in SQLite: `id`, `name`, `created_at`.

## Technical choices

- **Stored in SQLite**: the favorites (id, name, date added), not the
  Pokémon data itself, because PokeAPI is the source of truth and TanStack
  Query already caches it. SQLite, not AsyncStorage, because I sort favorites
  by date added and need a quick "is this a favorite?" check by `id`.
- **Native feature**: haptics (`expo-haptics`) when you tap the favorite
  button on the detail screen, so you feel that it worked. The alternative
  was Share, but a favorite tap is the action people do most.

## Technical core

- [ ] Runs in Expo Go
- [ ] Live data through TanStack Query
- [ ] At least 2 screens with Expo Router
- [ ] Something in SQLite that survives a restart
- [ ] Loading and error state on every load
- [ ] One native feature: haptics, on the favorite button (detail screen)
- [ ] TypeScript and ESLint without errors
- [ ] UI, data and logic in separate files

## Optional

- [ ] Clean TypeScript: no `any`, no `as` casts, no `@ts-ignore`
- [ ] Design: pixel perfect, as in the Figma file
- [ ] No warnings: no `console.log`, none in the terminal or on screen

## Out of scope

- Accounts or sync between phones.
- Moves, abilities, items, locations.
- Battles.
- A web version.

Build the Pokemon detail screen with three tabs (About, Stats, Evolution), integrate favorites functionality with SQLite, and add haptic feedback. Each API endpoint will have its own TanStack Query hook.

### Files to Create/Modify

**New Files:**
- \`src/services/favorites.ts\` - SQLite database setup and SQL operations for favorites table
- \`src/hooks/usePokemon.ts\` - Hook for \`/pokemon/{id}\` endpoint
- \`src/hooks/usePokemonSpecies.ts\` - Hook for \`/pokemon-species/{id}\` endpoint  
- \`src/hooks/useEvolutionChain.ts\` - Hook for \`/evolution-chain/{id}\` endpoint
- \`src/hooks/useFavorites.ts\` - TanStack Query hooks for favorites (get all, check if favorite, add, remove)

**Modified Files:**
- \`src/app/pokemon/[id].tsx\` - Replace placeholder with full detail screen implementation
- \`src/app/_layout.tsx\` - Initialize SQLite database on app startup
- \`AGENTS.md\` - Add SQLite database to shared setup section

### Technical Approach

**Database:**
- SQLite table: \`favorites\` with columns \`id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY\`, \`name TEXT\`, \`created_at INTEGER\`
- Database initialized in root layout, exposed via context or singleton pattern
- All SQL operations in \`src/services/favorites.ts\`

**API Queries:**
- Three separate TanStack Query hooks for the three PokeAPI endpoints
- Follow existing pattern from \`usePokemonList.ts\`
- Each hook returns loading/error states

**UI Structure:**
- Header with Pokemon name, number, artwork, and types (colored by type)
- Favorite button (heart icon) in header with haptic feedback
- Tab navigator for About/Stats/Evolution tabs
- Loading states for both main Pokemon data and evolution chain
- Error boundaries for each data fetch

**Favorites Integration:**
- \`useFavorites\` hook provides: \`useFavoritesList()\`, \`useIsFavorite(id)\`, \`useAddFavorite()\`, \`useRemoveFavorite()\`
- Mutations invalidate relevant queries for instant UI updates
- Toggle favorite triggers haptic feedback via \`expo-haptics\`

### Uncertainties
- Should the database be initialized via a singleton pattern or React context? (Will check existing patterns in codebase)
- Evolution chain endpoint returns nested structures - need to flatten for the UI display

- [x] Install \`expo-haptics\` and \`expo-sqlite\`

- [x] Create \`src/hooks/useFavorites.ts\` with all favorites operations
- [x] Build Pokemon detail screen in \`src/app/pokemon/[id].tsx\`:
  - [x] Header with artwork, name, number, types
  - [x] Favorite button with haptic feedback
  - [x] Tab navigation (About/Stats/Evolution)
  - [x] About tab content
  - [x] Stats tab content  
  - [x] Evolution tab content with navigation
  - [x] Loading states
  - [x] Error states
- [x] Update \`AGENTS.md\` shared setup section
- [x] Run \`npx tsc --noEmit\` - must pass
- [x] Run \`npx expo lint\` - must pass
